class.label: Lending oracle reads TWAP from a thin AMM pool with permissionless update; flash-swap fixes the price

remediation.summary: Do not price collateral via a TWAP read from a single thin AMM pool. Use a Chainlink feed (with staleness/heartbeat checks), or require deep TWAP liquidity over multiple venues. If retaining a Keep3r-style update path, restrict update() to a permissioned keeper or impose a deviation/cooldown threshold.
